name: NATTHA BHUM
dataConfidence: SOURCE-ANCHORED / AMCOL CALIBRATED DERIVED TRAINING MODEL
calibrationBasis: Verified company/ClassNK particulars anchor LOA/LBP/B/D, summer draught 10.014 m, DWT 24,712.303 t and 1,930 TEU. Design displacement is AMCOL-derived by calibrating the container-hull family to Cb=0.710 at summer draught; derived lightship = design displacement − published DWT. Upright hydrostatics and KN are scaled/calibrated from the AMCOL numerical container-hull family and are not official NATTHA BHUM stability-booklet data. KN ordinates are post-calibrated for small-angle consistency with the same hydrostatic KMT table. Public source data do not provide FWD/AFT draught or trim; those remain condition-dependent AMCOL-derived values.

principalParticulars.draftDataBoundary: Official/ClassNK public particulars provide summer draught only; forward draught, aft draught and trim are not publicly provided and remain condition-dependent AMCOL-derived outputs.

downflooding.basis: No approved/public vessel opening data located; representative deck-edge/opening cues are visual teaching aids only
